description: NSW Safety Performance Indicators Observational Survey is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Transport for NSW. The NSW Safety Performance Indicators Observational Study report aims to identify key road user behaviours through monitoring of Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs). This study focuses on identifying the gaps for the following road user behaviours: light vehicle seat belt use, motorcycle helmet and protective gear use and bicycle helmet use. Coverage is New South Wales, 2020 to 2021; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as infrequent, the status as unknown, and the entry was last changed on 2025-02-24. Files and pages listed: PDF (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
